llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: 1) Unverified claims of SEC licensing and compliance, 2) Vague and unverifiable company and location details, 3) Unusually generous terms such as zero transaction fees, 4) Prominent psychological urgency tactics, 5) No functioning business contact, only a suspicious domain-specific email, 6) No external links or factual verification, 7) Recently registered domain using privacy shielding and currently on 'clientHold' status. All factors strongly match the profile of a cryptocurrency scam website.
